defs.meaning: 逗乐，逗笑；（提供）消遣，（使）娱乐

examples.en: It amuses you and it doesn't hurt me.
examples.zh: 它让你开心，又不会伤害我。

examples.en: If it amuses you perhaps it won't do you any harm.
examples.zh: 如果它使你感到有趣，也许并不会对你有什么害处。

examples.en: "Well," cried the Marionette, angrily this time, "may I know, Mr. Parrot, what amuses you so?"
examples.zh: “喂，”木偶这次生气地叫道，“鹦鹉先生，我能知道是什么让你这么开心吗？”
